statement: Assume AC. Every nonempty irreducible separated finite-type complex variety is analytically connected. For every locally closed algebraic subset of such a variety, its analytic closure equals its Zariski closure.
construction: Finite Noether normalization and integral primitive-element polynomial; finite sheet clopen partition yields bounded holomorphic polynomial factors, Riemann extension and polydisc coefficient estimates contradict irreducibility; normalized curve arcs give Zariski-open analytic density and closure comparison.
